about:
Imagination Fabrication, LLC was established in 2009 by Nick Spring in Apex, North Carolina. The company began as a provider of metal fabrication, installation, and commercial truck repair services for customers throughout the Raleigh–Durham metro area, including Apex, Cary, Durham, Raleigh, Holly Springs, Garner, and surrounding communities.

The shop offers custom welding, metal fabrication, CNC plasma cutting, equipment repair, and wheel repair, with mobile welding services that bring equipment to the job site. Capabilities extend to entrance gate construction, dumpster door fabrication, restaurant equipment fabrication and repair, custom bumper and rack building, frame and roll‑cage work, and fuel tank fabrication and repair. The company also stocks a range of metal supplies for contractors and DIYers.

Clients include commercial truck operators needing diesel repairs, restaurants requiring custom equipment, property owners seeking gates and railings, and contractors sourcing metal materials. Projects have ranged from custom art pieces to structural roll cages and fuel tanks, serving the construction, transportation, food‑service, and residential markets in central North Carolina.

The company emphasizes the technical knowledge and hands‑on experience of its associates, combined with a specialization in aluminum and the ability to work with steel, brass, cast iron, stainless steel, and titanium. Mobile welding and a stocked metal supply yard are cited as key differentiators for customers who need on‑site service or materials for their own projects.
